about: Answer key for request.as-of, request.issuer and sources.sha256-required (step 3A, PR 10a), written by the controller by reading before the code (planner's draft checked row by row; rulings in .superpowers/sdd/3a/10/rulings.md). SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: every name, date, file and digest is invented. A document is front + title + '## Request' line + request + '## Sources' line + sources + '## Findings' line + findings + tail; a case gives only the parts it changes. kind is data and other_sources is ["src"] unless a case says otherwise; as_of is an ISO date; pins is a list of [name, sha256]; upstream maps a module code to a fixture path under tests/fixtures/handoffs/. Placeholders in sources, pins and quoted text: {d:C} is the character C 64 times; {d:C!} is C 63 times then 0; {sha:CP-X} is the sha256 of the upstream document CP-X. Each expected finding is [check, severity, line, quoted], compared whole and in order; reason maps a finding's position to its exact reason.
